build_poisson_training_start: build a PoissonAsyncTrainingStartTimeDistr to generate exponentially distributed training start times for async FL simulation
build_constant_training_start: build a ConstantAsyncTrainingStartTimeDistr to generate fixed-interval training start times based on a configurable training rate
build_async_event_generator: build an AsyncTrainingEventGenerator to generate both training start times and training duration events for async FL
build_event_generator_from_list: build an AsyncTrainingEventGeneratorFromList to simulate deterministic training events from a fixed list for unit testing
review_event_timing_info: review the EventTimingInfo dataclass to understand prev_event_start_to_current_start and duration fields for async FL event timing
